[Issue #8257] Create & link assistance listing table (#8429)

## Summary

<!-- Use "Fixes" to automatically close issue upon PR merge. Use "Work
for" when UAT is required. -->
Fixes #8257 

## Changes proposed

<!-- What was added, updated, or removed in this PR. -->
1. Create a table for Assistance Listing with these columns (minimum):
assistance_listing_record_id, assistance_listing_number, and title
2. Link the Opportunity table to the new Assistance Listing table (link
column assistance_listing_record_id, nullable with a foreign key
constraint).
3. Seed the table with a minimum of 3 Assistance Listing Number (ALN)
records. This will be used for development, testing and the POC.

## Context for reviewers

<!-- Technical or background context, more in-depth details of the
implementation, and anything else you'd like reviewers to know about
that will help them understand the changes in the PR. -->
Code Changes:
1. create a new table, call it assistance_listing (in the same
opportunity_model.py file) with only these 3 fields. (NOTE: because the
sam.gov API calls the assistance_listing_number field
assistance_listing_id, use assistance_listing_record_id here for our
internal DB UUID for less confusion.)
- assistance_listing_record_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID]...,
- assistance_listing_number: Mapped[str, index=True]
- program_title: Mapped[str]

2. Modify the OpportunityAssistanceListing table. This existing table
will support BOTH (a) opportunities imported from Grants.gov and (b)
going forward, it will link the Opportunity to AssistanceListing for
opportunities created in Simpler Grants. Eventually, we will transition
to using it as a link table only (i.e. only use the foreign key,
assistance_listing_record_id, and drop the fields:
assistance_listing_number, program_title and
legacy_opportunity_assistance_listing_id).
- change the legacy_opportunity_assistance_listing_id field to be
nullable
- Add a link to the AssistanceListing table, joining on the
assistance_listing_record_id, nullable (for backwards compatibility with
historical records), with a foreign key constraint.

3. Update the seed_local_db.py file to insert 3+ records into the new
AssistanceListing table for the MVP/demo. (Created
AssistanceListingFactory to facilitate this.)

4. Generated migrations scripts for the DB Schema updates

## Validation steps

<!-- Manual testing instructions, as well as any helpful references
(screenshots, GIF demos, code examples or output). -->
1. Review the code changes
2. Run make db-migrate to apply the DB changes
3. Verify that the assistance_listing table was created and seeded with
5 dummy records. Select * from api.assistance_listing;
4. Verify that the opportunity_assistance_table has a new column,
assistance_listing_record_id, that it is a uuid field, and that it has a
foreign key constraint to the assistance_listing table. This field will
be empty/null for now.
